name: group_scene_op
description: Remove a member from a group/scene, or update how an existing member is linked (link type, on-level, ramp rate, etc.). To add a member -- including a single one, whether creating a new group/scene or adding to an existing one -- use `multi_device_scene` instead. remove_member is destructive -- only after the customer has explicitly agreed, never speculatively. For update_link, call get_group_detail first and base the new `link` on that member's existing one. One member per call -- call it once per member.

group_address.description: The group/scene's real id, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE -- never guessed.

link_address.description: The member device's real id, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE -- never guessed.

link.description: update_link only: the member's new link object, in the same shape get_group_detail returns for that member's existing link (its link type -- native/default/command/ignore -- plus its per-link parameters such as on-level and ramp rate). Copy that existing link and change only what the customer asked for -- never invent keys.
